Action Input: {"path": "/results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/aluminum_npt_relaxation_subtask_quenching_trial_4/in.npt_relax", "content": "# LAMMPS input script for Al NPT relaxation

units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Create simulation box and atoms
lattice fcc 4.05  # Aluminum lattice constant in Angstroms
region box block 0 5 0 5 0 5
create_box 1 box
create_atoms 1 box

# Define potential
pair_style eam/alloy
pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/claude_35/react/quenching/brief/subtasks/aluminum_potential_file_subtask_quenching_trial_4/Al99.eam.alloy Al

# Initialize velocities
velocity all create 300 12345 dist gaussian

# Define compute for density
compute density all property/atom mass
compute mass_total all reduce sum c_density
variable volume equal vol
variable density equal c_mass_total/(v_volume*6.022e23)*10

# Timestep
timestep 1.0

# Energy minimization
minimize 1.0e-6 1.0e-8 1000 10000

# NPT relaxation
fix 1 all npt temp 300 300 100 iso 0 0 1000
thermo 1000
thermo_style custom step temp press density vol

run 10000

# Output final structure and density
variable final_density equal v_density
print "Final density = ${final_density} g/cm^3" file density.txt
write_data relaxed.data"}
